verdict.rationale: Evidence only vaguely references building 'reports' and pulling data for 'dashboards' and 'marketing performance' analysis, without any documentation of specific metrics (opens, clicks, unsubscribes, conversions) broken down per campaign or per automation step over time. Missing for 10: dedicated analytics/reporting docs showing per-campaign and per-automation-step breakdowns of opens/clicks/unsubscribes/conversions, historical trend views, and any independent corroboration of this reporting UI.
